[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 8. Baked Beans and Sausage: Use canned navy beans, sausage, and tomato sauce.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 9. Lentil Soup: Blend canned lentils with veggies and broth.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 10. Bean and Cheese Dip: Mix canned black beans with sour cream, salsa, and cheese.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 11. Stuffed Bell Peppers: Fill bell peppers with canned black beans, rice, and ground meat.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] 12. Bean and Veggie Burgers: Add canned beans to burger recipes.
